## `neuro.bigInt64Array.slice`

Instance method on `BigInt64Array.prototype`.

> Returns a section of an array.

## Signatures

```ts
slice(input: { bigInt64Array: <receiver>; start?: number; end?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<BigInt64Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `BigInt64Array.prototype.slice` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
